facts.fact: The D4D Hub research paper states that Zambia's Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021 requires sensitive personal data (health records, biometrics, religious beliefs, political opinions) to be stored within the country, quoting Section 70 that sensitive personal data can only be stored in Zambia and other personal data goes on servers in the Republic unless transfer is approved.
